name: eson
description: ESON — ExtendScript Object Notation: a strict JSON parser/stringify library for ExtendScript (ES3) engines

scripts.estc:live: node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESON.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/vendor-eson.js --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESON-runtime.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/vendor-eson-runtime.js --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESON.facade.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESON.accel.jsx --no-target --live --launch && node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESON.accel.min.jsx --no-target --live --launch
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:vendor && npm run test:poly
scripts.release:gate: npm run verify && npm run fuzz && npm run build:accel:strict && npm run estc:check && npm run estc:live && npm run live-verify && npm run live-artifacts && npm run accel-live
